envelope.author: IsolatedImplementer
envelope.reason: assay not-achieved asks for what the spec excludes and the agent definition cannot express

payload.title: isolated-implementer worktree cannot be placed off the plan's line by the agent definition
payload.body: The spec for isolated-implementer of remaining-gaps makes the harness start the implementer in a worktree (claude front matter 'isolation: worktree', landed at 8d36288d) and says it branches from the default branch or the dispatcher's HEAD, so moving its work onto plan/<plan> stays the implementer's competence. The assay (ledger entry 2) asks the worktree itself to be off the plan's line. Claude Code's per-agent front matter carries no base ref: baseRef is a session setting (worktree.baseRef: fresh|head), and anything per-plan would need a WorktreeCreate hook that replaces worktree creation and resolves the bound plan, none of which the spec names or its outputs cover. Ruling needed: accept the spec as built (isolation starts a worktree; landing on the plan's line stays the implementer's competence and isolated-landing enforces it at land), or widen the unit to a WorktreeCreate hook or baseRef route.
